# Retrieve the cached attraction results for Memphis (Sporting type)
attractions_results = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Search for hotels in Memphis with the specified criteria
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="Memphis",
    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-04"],
    num_people=3,
    budget=45,
    stars=[1],
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on the user's amenities (pool and room service)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest sporting attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_results,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Output the query summary
print("No planning needed")
